SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE dist.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bond_type = '#' THEN molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM bond

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM connected c JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id) ) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS percentage FROM atom a;
SELECT T1.id FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode WHERE T2.language = 'Japanese' AND T1.isFoilOnly = 1 AND T1.isForeignOnly = 0;

SELECT T1.name 
FROM cards AS T1 
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode 
WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap' 
AND T1.convertedManaCost = (
    SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) 
    FROM cards T3 
    INNER JOIN sets T4 ON T4.code = T3.setCode 
    WHERE T4.name = 'Coldsnap'
)
ORDER BY T1.name ASC;

SELECT T2.name FROM foreign_data AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T3.code = T2.setCode WHERE T3.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.language = 'Italian' ORDER BY T2.convertedManaCost DESC
SELECT name FROM cards JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid WHERE legalities.format = 'duel' ORDER BY convertedManaCost DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT setCode FROM set_translations WHERE language = 'Japanese';

SELECT c.Text
FROM comments c
JOIN posts p ON p.Id = c.PostId
WHERE p.Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM postHistory ph
    WHERE ph.PostId = p.Id
      AND ph.UserId = c.UserId
  )
ORDER BY c.CreationDate;
SELECT T3.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.BountyAmount = 50 AND T1.Title LIKE '%variance%';
SELECT SUM(FavoriteCount) \nFROM posts \nWHERE OwnerUserId = 686 AND strftime('%Y', CreaionDate) = '2011';
SELECT Id, Title FROM posts ORDER BY Score DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT Count FROM tags WHERE TagName = 'careers';

SELECT colour.colour AS EyeColor, COUNT(superhero.id) AS Count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(superhero.id) DESC) AS PopularityRank FROM superhero INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' GROUP BY colour.colour ORDER BY PopularityRank ASC;

SELECT T2.publisher_name, ABS((SELECT COUNT(S1.id) FROM superhero AS S1 INNER JOIN publisher AS P1 ON S1.publisher_id = P1.id WHERE P1.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') - (SELECT COUNT(S2.id) FROM superhero AS S2 INNER JOIN publisher AS P2 ON S2.publisher_id = P2.id WHERE P2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics')) AS Difference FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T2.publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') GROUP BY T2.publisher_name ORDER BY COUNT(T1.id) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.nationality FROM drivers AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T2.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL AND T2.fastestLapSpeed != '' ORDER BY CAST(T2.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT MAX(year) FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.name = 'Brands Hatch' AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix';

SELECT r.time
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2008
  AND r.position = 2;
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_api_id ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT t3.team_long_name FROM Team AS t3 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t4 ON t3.team_api_id = t4.team_api_id WHERE t4.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND SUBSTR(t4.date, 1, 4) = '2014' AND t4.chanceCreationPassing < (SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.chanceCreationPassing) AS REAL) / COUNT(t1.id) FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal' AND SUBSTR(t2.`date`, 1, 4) = '2014') ORDER BY t4.chanceCreationPassing DESC

FROM Laboratory
WHERE 
  (TP <= 6.0 OR TP >= 8.5) 
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '1997';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND l.WBC < 3.5;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND T1.SEX = 'M'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 50 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG >= 2000
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T2.RA = '-' OR T2.RA = '+-') AND T1.Birthday > '1985-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Examination AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RF IS NOT NULL AND T2.RF != 'NONE' AND CAST(REPLACE(T2.RF, '<', '') AS REAL) < 20 AND T1.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SC170 IN ('negative','0') AND T2.Date > '1997-01-01'
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`GOT` >= 60
